metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have the most amount of active fire detections in 2016 compared to all other years from 2012 to 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS or VIIRS active fire products - FIRMS dataset: "MODIS/006/MOD14A1" or "MODIS/061/MYD14A1" for fire detection - Better option: "FIRMS" dataset which provides fire detections - Actually, best is: "MODIS/006/MCD14ML" or the newer FIRMS collection - I'll use MODIS Collection 6.1 thermal anomalies: no direct GEE collection, so I'll use "MODIS/061/MOD14A2" or similar - Actually, the most appropriate is to use "FIRMS" data or count fire pixels from MOD14A1/MYD14A1 - Let me use: MODIS/006/MOD14A1 (Terra) and MODIS/006/MYD14A1 (Aqua) - these have FireMask band - Better yet: Use "ESA/CCI/FireCCI/5_1" which has burned area, or just count thermal anomalies - Most direct: Use MODIS thermal anomalies/fire detection bands from MOD14A1 2. Masking strategy: - Filter by FireMask band where confidence is high (values 7-9 indicate fire) - Count fire detections per year for Punjab and Haryana region 3. Logic: - Count fire detections for each year 2012-2024 in Punjab & Haryana - Compare 2016 count to all other years - If 2016 has the maximum count: Answer A - Otherwise: Answer B - Handle cases where data is missing or invalid ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Punjab and Haryana region (approximate bounding box) const punjabHaryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[73.5, 28.5], [77.5, 28.5], [77.5, 32.0], [73.5, 32.0], [73.5, 28.5]] ]); // Function to count fire detections for a given year function countFires(year) { const startDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 1, 1); const endDate = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 31); // Use MODIS Thermal Anomalies/Fire 8-Day product const fires = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD14A2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(punjabHaryana) .select('FireMask'); const imageCount = fires.size().getInfo(); if (imageCount === 0) { return { year: year, count: 0, images: 0, valid: false }; } // FireMask: 7-9 are fire pixels (7=low, 8=nominal, 9=high confidence) const fireMask = fires.map(function(img) { return img.gte(7); }).sum(); const fireCount = fireMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: punjabHaryana, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('FireMask'); const count = fireCount.getInfo(); return { year: year, count: count !== null ? count : 0, images: imageCount, valid: count !== null }; } // Analyze all years from 2012 to 2024 console.log("Counting fire detections for Punjab & Haryana (2012-2024)..."); const years = [2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024]; const results = []; for (let year of years) { const result = countFires(year); results.push(result); console.log(`${year}: Fires=${result.count}, Images=${result.images}`); } // Check if all years returned valid data const validResults = results.filter(r => r.valid && r.images > 0); if (validResults.length === 0) { console.log("No valid fire data found for any year."); console.log("C1"); return; } if (validResults.length < years.length) { console.log(`Warning: Only ${validResults.length}/${years.length} years have valid data.`); } // Find year with maximum fire count const maxResult = validResults.reduce((max, r) => r.count > max.count ? r : max); console.log(`\nMaximum fires: ${maxResult.count} in ${maxResult.year}`); // Check if 2016 has the most fires const result2016 = results.find(r => r.year === 2016); if (!result2016 || !result2016.valid) { console.log("2016 data is invalid or missing."); console.log("C1"); return; } if (result2016.count === maxResult.count && maxResult.year === 2016) { console.log("2016 had the most fire detections."); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("2016 did NOT have the most fire detections."); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
